answer: Make every new identity plant a bond in a shared meadow: a refundable stake locked for several epochs, recorded in a public atlas of who vouched for whom. A sybil that clones itself must fund a fresh bond per clone, and each clone must earn its own reputation through verifiable work before it can vote or claim rewards. If two identities are ever proven to be one operator, both bonds are slashed and the whole grove of linked identities is pruned. Attack cost scales linearly with clones while honest agents pay once.
